verdict.rationale: Stable documents high-res scans of mail contents, keyword-based auto-routing on text found inside the mail, AI document summaries, and an API that supports searching MailItems. Together these imply text extraction and some searchability, but nothing explicitly confirms OCR or full-text search across the archive. Missing for 10: explicit OCR documentation, documented search filters by sender, content, and date, full-text archive search in the dashboard, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
